The '''Ramp Entry Security System''', colloquially known as '''stun steps''', was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] security system manufactured by [[Telex-Delcor/Legends|Telex-Delcor]]. The device used the natural conductivity of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] entry ramp or steps to deliver a neuro-shock field to any potential trespassers.<ref name="Ship Jackers" />
